gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-figtree: Wide-set and showy, Bruno Ace SC strings its letters out like beads on a thread, with no thinning anywhere. Figtree does the quieter job, its marker-tip sans keeping text friendly.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-finlandica: Spaced out and unmistakable. Bruno Ace SC earns its keep when it's big and brief, while Finlandica keeps its plain sans outline you could trace with a finger.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-fustat: Bruno Ace SC spreads its letters like beads on a long thread, open and never thinning to a hairline. Fustat's rope-like lines give it a bendy, modern counterweight.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-gantari: Approachable is the surprise here, since Bruno Ace SC looks so showy, with its beaded, widely spaced letters. And Gantari keeps a wire-bent plain sans look flowing, with wide c apertures making each line easy going.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-gayathri: Expressive from the first word, Bruno Ace SC keeps every stem and crossbar at one thickness. But Gayathri's thin strokes, about half the weight of its thick ones, give the pair its sharpest difference.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-google-sans-flex: Google Sans Flex reads like a plain sans cut from one ribbon, each curve ending in a clean, open gap. Bruno Ace SC adds the spread-out, expressive swagger above it, and that mix is the pair's draw.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-gothic-a1: Approachable text meets an expressive heading here, with Gothic A1 holding a splayed c terminal below Bruno Ace SC. And the strongest quality is how the heading never swells or thins, while the body does so lightly.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-gotu: Gotu reads as a plain sans with sturdy hairlines and open-mouthed e crossbars, modern and tidy. And its size is the one to adjust, since Bruno Ace SC holds a constant stroke from top to baseline already.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-gruppo: Gruppo brings a sans-serif voice whose curve endings never come near each other, crisp and professional. But Bruno Ace SC is the one that makes noise, with no thin strokes to vanish in glare.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-gudea: Beaded, wide-spaced letters make Bruno Ace SC instantly recognizable, open throughout and never thinning. Gudea follows as a friendly sans-serif whose curves hold a thread-like thickness, with glass-clear gaps keeping paragraphs smooth.
